description: Search US federal civil-service job postings — by keyword, location, pay grade (GS-1 to GS-15, SES), agency, position type. Returns position title, agency, location, salary range, grade, open period, application URL. USAJOBS is the ONLY source for US federal civil-service postings, distinct from BLS, ESCO, CareerJet, Adzuna, Reed, Jooble, Arbeitnow, Remotive, and TheirStack.

keyword.description: Free-text search across job title + description. Examples: 'software engineer', 'cybersecurity analyst', 'data scientist'.

location_name.description: Location filter. City + state, ZIP, or state name. Examples: 'Washington, DC', 'San Francisco, CA', '94102'.

organization.description: Agency code or name fragment. Examples: 'DOD' (Defense), 'VA' (Veterans Affairs), 'HHS' (Health and Human Services).

pay_grade_high.description: Maximum federal pay grade (same format as pay_grade_low).

pay_grade_low.description: Minimum federal pay grade. Format: 'GS01'-'GS15', 'SES', or 'EX-V'. Default: any.

position_title.description: Strict position-title filter. Use keyword for fuzzy match.

name: usajobs.jobs.search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: USAJOBS Federal Job Search
